title: MCARPA
body:
This pack consists primarily of textures ported from the 1.12.2 version of [Minecraft Comes Alive](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/minecraft-comes-alive-mca), available under the GNU General Public License v3. Some textures were modified or made entirely from scratch.

Though it is incomplete, this is unlikely to receive further updates. Texture submissions are nonetheless welcome in the linked Discord server.
